name: Comet
summary: Comets on looping paths with the music: white-hot heads in coloured glows, tails that widen and fade, sparks shed behind them.
hint: Each comet moves on the music clock, so it races when the music is loud; its glow swells on each beat. The tails are kept from frame to frame, moved, blurred a little and faded, so it widens and softens as it ages. Sparks fly off the heads, a burst on the bar's first beat.

params.label: Figure
params.help: Circle, Eight and Knot share one figure; with Wander each comet loops on its own.

params.label: Bar flare
params.help: How much more the glows swell on the first beat of each bar.

params.label: Opens in a build
params.help: How far the paths widen through a build, until the drop.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.

params.label: Sparks
params.help: How bright the sparks shed by the heads are; 0 sheds none.

params.label: Trail
params.help: How long the trail takes to fade to a third.

params.label: Spread
params.help: How fast the tail widens and softens as it ages.

params.label: Drift
params.help: How fast the trail moves outward.
